cnbc.title: Tech stocks had a nice oversold bounce on Monday. Earnings this week will determine if it's for real
cnbc.desc: Investors are hopeful that last week's pullback was a clearing event for equities, but lingering concerns remain.

cnbc.title: OpenAI bugging suspect Alfozan held without bail after Saudi government offers to pay
cnbc.desc: Saudi national Abdulrahman Alfozan is accused of planting a recording device in an executive conference room at OpenAI headquarters in San Francisco.

cnbc.title: Trump says he'd meet with Putin and Xi, criticizes Zelenskyy
cnbc.desc: Tensions between Trump and Zelenskyy have steadily risen in recent weeks, while Russia, which invaded Ukraine, has received multiple breaks from the U.S.

cnbc.title: Saudi Arabia postpones big investor conference to 2027 as Iran-backed Houthis escalate attacks on kingdom
cnbc.desc: Iran-backed Houthi militants have launched repeated volleys of missiles and drones at Saudi Arabia since a deadly airport attack earlier this month.

cnbc.title: Apple announces product launch event for Oct. 28. Analysts expect touchscreen laptop
cnbc.desc: Apple sent invitations for an event next week, calling it "Pro and tell."

cnbc.title: Anthropic is AI trade's last big hope for a major IPO this year
cnbc.desc: On Kalshi, Anthropic is seen as the last major IPO in 2026 after OpenAI delayed its public market debut. Others have postponed too.

cnbc.title: Google says it can build data centers the right way. Some experts and residents are skeptical
cnbc.desc: Google says its Minnesota AI data center will add clean energy to the grid and protect ratepayers. Experts question whether grid upgrades are needed.

cnbc.title: Elon Musk says he'll give a SpaceX share to every child in America next year
cnbc.desc: The SpaceX boss said Monday that he'll give one of his company shares to every child in the U.S. next year. He didn't say how the share giveaway would happen.

cnbc.title: Gartner analyst behind tech rout: AI returns are not yet large enough to justify neocloud build-out
cnbc.desc: The firm stands behind analysis that sent shockwaves through the market last week.

cnbc.title: French unrest compounds debt crisis fears. Paris-listed stocks, bonds and the euro fall
cnbc.desc: "It looks like either the bond markets riot, or the people riot, or both," one analyst told CNBC.

cnbc.title: In pictures: More than 500,000 took to the streets as France protests erupted into violence
cnbc.desc: Over 500,000 people took part in protests in France over the weekend, which became marred by violence, amid demonstrations against rising living costs.

cnbc.title: NYSE becomes latest exchange to extend options hours as appetite for around-the-clock trading grows
cnbc.desc: The New York Stock Exchange becomes second major exchange to announce extended-hours options trading for heavily traded ETFs and single stocks, following CBOE.

cnbc.title: Women may be at greater risk of AI job losses. Telephone switch operators and PCs show why
cnbc.desc: The history of technological progress suggests that as AI spreads, the employment impact will hit women more than men.

cnbc.title: Cornell sexual assault case has some prospective students rethinking plans, consultants say
cnbc.desc: Some prospective Cornell University students are rethinking applications amid the Jane Doe sexual assault lawsuit, college admissions consultants say.

cnbc.title: Robot factories and hypersonic missiles: JPMorgan Chase's first $5 billion of defense investments
cnbc.desc: With $5 billion already deployed off its balance sheet, JPMorgan Chase is racing ahead on direct investments in defense tech, hardware and supply chains.
